sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:5

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:5:1
items.html:
Their ascent in the secret of MAN, and they cause a coupling in AVI, etc.: That is to say, the records of ZAT — which are the discernment of GE bound to the AHP of AVI, as above — are included in the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] of AVI themselves, and AVI truly couple upon their own MAN. Rather, through the inclusion of the records of ZAT within them — an inclusion that arouses in AVI that discernment of MAN of Katnut [smallness/infancy] suited to the discernment of those records, that is, fitting for the level of the Ibur [impregnation].
Thus it is found that the whole level of MAD [male waters] and MAN that went out through this inclusion belongs to these records, which are ZAT, since they were the cause of the measure of this coupling; and AVI themselves have no need at all for the measure of this level.
